items.title: Dow beats second-quarter expectations as pricing strength lifts earnings (NYSE:DOW)
items.summary: Dow (NYSE:DOW) reported better-than-expected second-quarter earnings on Thursday, supported by higher selling prices across its business, particularly in polyethylene, helping offset a modest decline in sales volumes. The stronger results prompted a positive market reaction, with the company’s shares rising more than 2% in premarket trading.
